image_description: A close-up, high-angle shot of a black cast-iron skillet filled with a hearty stew containing chunks of carrots, potatoes, onions, and meat in a rich reddish-brown sauce. The pan's rim and a portion of its handle are visible at the bottom left. The food fills most of the frame, obscuring the full geometry of the pan.

The thickness of the cast iron rim appears inconsistent; it thins out abruptly near the handle junction in a way that might be structurally weak for real cast iron, though subtle.
